description: This file contains shell script functions related to migrating LED sysfs configurations and applying migrations, primarily dealing with configuration retrieval, manipulation, and logging for system LEDs.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates sysfs entries for LEDs based on provided configuration and tuple list.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes device name prefixes from sysfs entries unless exceptions are specified.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies LED sysfs migrations for each LED entry.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and removes device name prefixes from all LED entries.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Applies configuration changes for a specified realm if there are pending changes.
